VI.description: Image carrier for the class and library icon helpers of lvai_set_owner_icon and lvai_read_icons. It holds an icon IN MEMORY only so that its image data can be read and moved to a .lvclass or .lvlib - no helper ever saves it. Measured 2026-10-08 on LabVIEW 2026 Q3 32-bit with labview-mcp 1.8.5 in a pilot project (a class with six members, project closed).
